Our Programs & Field Initiatives

Comprehensive educational, health, and climate adaptation programs designed for high-risk coastal environments.

CHILD EDUCATION

1. Sundarbans Learning Hubs & Scholarships

Establishing community-managed learning centers, providing textbooks, school supplies, and teacher support to keep children in school.

Our learning hubs serve as safe, vibrant spaces where children receive after-school tutoring, foundational literacy training, and mentorship during seasonal salinity disruptions.

Key Program Targets

  • 15 active community learning hubs in Kaliganj & Shyamnagar
  • Free educational kits (books, backpacks, uniforms)
  • Teacher training & monthly stipend support
  • 94% school retention rate among enrolled students

Health & Hygiene Impact

  • 35 hygiene literacy workshops for mothers and teenage girls
  • Distribution of clean drinking water purification tablets
  • Promotion of safe sanitation in salinity-affected villages
  • 5,000+ total community participants reached
HEALTH & AWARENESS

2. Clean Water & Hygiene Literacy

Conducting hygiene education, promoting clean water awareness, and providing hygiene kits in salinity-impacted coastal villages.

Severe salinity in Satkhira's water supply causes widespread skin and gastrointestinal illnesses. We educate coastal mothers and youth on household water management and preventive health care.

CLIMATE ACTION

3. Coastal Climate Preparedness & Youth Action

Training local youth in emergency cyclone preparedness, tree planting, and community safety protocols during severe weather events.

Empowering local youth as first responders during cyclone seasons ensures faster evacuation assistance, tree barrier planting along vulnerable embankments, and emergency aid distribution.

Climate Action Highlights

  • 250 trained youth disaster response volunteers
  • Mangrove & coastal tree plantation along embankments
  • Emergency relief kit distribution during severe storms
  • 12 coastal villages covered across Satkhira
